models.low: Single-event favourable/total only; abstain on conditional or two-draw tasks, including intermediate inventory.
models.mixed: Multiply initial bag fractions, sum both orders; never update bag without replacement. Count remaining from that unchanged bag.
models.strong: Update bag on no replacement, conditional fractions, multiply paths and sum both orders.

method: New deterministic parser; same mathematical abilities; technical transfer, not independent blind review.
